sloka: संस्थम्भ राम भद्रम् ते मा शुचः पुरुषोत्तम ।न ईदृइशानाम् मतिः मन्दा भवति अकलुषात्मनाम् ॥४-१-११५॥
transliteration: saṁsthambha rāma bhadram te mā śucaḥ puruṣottama ।na īdṛiśānām matiḥ mandā bhavati akaluṣātmanām ॥4-1-115॥

translations.english: 'O Rama, the foremost of men, control yourself. Be blessed. People who are pure at heart do not feel depressed at heart.
